label: D2 arrival at S1 that departs from recent S2 experience (switch into S1 or rare a2->S1), early in the episode only
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the state shown is S1 (zero activations at D1, GO, or on S2). It is also confined to the first ~40-50 trials of an episode (rate 12% in trials 0-9, falling to 0 from trial 50 on), so a slow drift in the hidden state switches it off. Within early S1 arrivals it fires when S1 is new relative to recent experience: either a rare transition (chose a2, landed in S1) or the previous trial reached S2, e.g. switching from a2 to a1 and landing in S1 commonly. The strongest activations (~1.0 of max) are common a1->S1 right after a run of a2/S2 trials; rare a2->S1 gives ~0.8. Repeated S1 arrivals after S1 are mostly silent or weak. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables (D2 state, this trial s choice, previous state, trial time). Dev: P 0.80, R 0.78, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.86. Most of the remaining misses are weak activations on the first trial of the window, where prev_state is unknown to the predicate. Using prev_state != 1 raises mass recall to 0.95 but drops precision to 0.66.
